headline: The square version of Dean's donor ad: a busy family of four that has given for 13 years, and kids who see every person they helped.
story: Dean has supported Watsi since 2013. A busy family of four, baseball and dance, and still: his kids see the profiles of the people they supported. He ends on being able to help other people throughout the world. One ask: join in with Dean and give today.
Same plan as the vertical ad DR05, laid out for a square: the gradient and the type fill the whole frame.
do: Hook text on frame 1, then the Who Gives card.
Fill the whole square: no vertical-shaped border.
Show one real patient profile on “the profiles”.
Credit is first name and year only.
dont: No vertical panel or border inside the square (Atdhe, 22 Oct).
No dollar amount in the hook.
No music, no patient B-roll under his voice.
No photo of Dean (none cleared for paid).
No logo before the end card.

files: LOTUS illustrations · September Spirit font · Watsi brand guide. Lato for all text. Navy #2E2844 is text only, never a background. Cyan #11BAED, light cyan #D3EDFA, yellow #FFCC33.
tech: Donor's own phone audio note (audio/mp4). No picture: the picture is kinetic type and Watsi's pulsing waveform on the Who Gives gradient.
1080×1080 square, 30 fps. The type and the gradient fill the whole square: no vertical 9:16 panel or border inside it.

The page draws graphics and caption clips at 1080×1920. Put them on the square timeline at 100% and move them up or down until the text sits where the row says (width is the same 1080). Keep every word inside the square with a margin.
Top banner from the approved ad design (Sonam, 1 Oct: CTA as a top banner on 1:1). Same words as the latest approved version. Letters spaced so r and n never touch (learn, earned, owned).
Light noise-floor clean only. Never re-voice. No music, no other sound under the donor.

Who Gives pop-up words: Lato Bold, white with a soft shadow, word by word, no box, no highlight, no jumpy animation. Never drop out. Every Watsi written by hand (the transcript writes WOTC). The caption clips sit about 880 px down the square when centred.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1080. One file. The vertical is a separate item.
checklist: Frame 1 is the hook text on the gradient. Not the Who Gives card.
No vertical-shaped border: the gradient fills the square (Atdhe, 22 Oct).
The Who Gives card says “Hear from Dean” and “Watsi donor since 2013”.
The last caption reads “throughout the world.” with the full stop.
Top banner letters spaced so r and n never touch.
No music. No leftover nat sound from old B-roll.
Watsi with a capital W; watsi.org lowercase.

decisions.b: The brief's hook and ask name a dollar amount. Money stays off this page: the hook uses his own words and the ask lives in the approved banner. Nick confirms the banner words.
The Deadline column is empty. Nick sets it.

client_note: Why this matters: Sonam asked for square ads with the CTA as a top banner. Atdhe's notes on V1 are about the border, the banner spacing and one caption.

transcript:
Auto-transcript of Dean's audio note (Who Gives campaign assets, Donor Generated Content, 58 s). Times are mm:ss.s in the file. The auto-transcript wrote WOTC for Watsi; it is corrected below.
--- Audio note_Dean_ ---
[00:00.2] Hi, my name is Dean and
[00:02.3] I've been a Watsi supporter for about 13 years now, started in 2013, which was actually a year before my daughter was born.
[00:13.3] And she's now 12 years old.
[00:15.2] My son's 10, we're a busy typical family of four with baseball practice, dance lessons.
[00:24.2] And despite all that, it's been really an amazing experience supporting Watsi.
[00:31.2] Also grateful that my kids have been involved as well.
[00:34.1] They can see the profiles of all the people we've supported who've needed a medical procedure that's changed their lives.
[00:42.6] And so it's been very rewarding for us as well to see and humbling to realize that we're fortunate to have health and we're able to help other people throughout the world through Watsi.
[00:53.2] And it's been a really wonderful experience.
